facts.text: pqlumi defines the concrete Measurement class.
pqlumi binds one module-level measurement instance of that class.
When delphi_pqlumi cannot be imported, pqlumi sets is_fake and prints that it uses a fake module.
A laser assembly is made up of a laser head, attenuator, main attenuator and shutter, accessed through the pqdc module.
The MCP tool disclaimer warns that generated code can put connected microscope hardware, including lasers and scanners, in a hazardous operating condition.
start_meas accepts only the measurement types "image", "line" and "point" in its docstring; it forwards the string to dm.start_meas.
stop_meas returns at once when is_fake; otherwise it calls dm.stop_meas, raises on an error return and returns nothing; the docstring does not promise a stop readback.
meas_status returns False while a measurement is inactive or stopped and True while it is running.
get_elapsed_meas_time returns the elapsed measurement time in seconds.
scan_range_min_x/max_x/min_y/max_y are in meters.
scan_range_left/top/width/height are in meters.
path_to_ptu is the absolute path of the last PTU file written.
img_conf.scan_speed is a percentage, image_size is a pixel tuple, and num_frames is a count.
img_conf.photons_in_brightest_px is a count and img_conf.meas_time is in seconds.
point_conf exposes a photon count, measurement time, stop flags, point_list in meters and selected_point in meters.
write_ptu_file enables or disables PTU output during a scan.
set_next_measurement_name sets the next measurement name and has no getter.
get_analysis_names lists the live analysis names configured in Luminosa.
get_analysis_curve_types lists the curve types available for one analysis.
get_analysis_image_types lists the image types available for one analysis.
get_analysis_param_types lists the parameter types available for one analysis.
get_analysis_curve returns the documented 1-D curve plus optional FCS fit arrays.
get_analysis_image returns a 2-D image and x/y/z positions in meters.
get_analysis_param returns a dict whose keys depend on the analysis and parameter type.
The upstream is_fake fallback returns a five-point curve.
The upstream is_fake fallback returns a 3x3 image; those values are the upstream's own test fallback, not a size or measurement of a real system.

safe_state.description: Measurement stopped through Measurement.stop_meas() and confirmed by meas_status() reading False; the clone does not show whether that changes a laser or shutter (closed delphi_pqlumi bridge), and the pqdc/pqscan laser, shutter and stage interfaces are not touched.
